description: This file defines the ProductType entity class for a Java-based e-commerce application. It includes ORM annotations for persistence, auditing capabilities, and getter/setter methods for its fields.

classes.name: ProductType
classes.description: Entity class representing a product type within the catalog, supporting auditing and database persistence.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product type.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit information associated with this product type.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for this product type.

methods.name: isAllowAddToCart
methods.description: Checks if adding this product type to cart is allowed.

methods.name: setAllowAddToCart
methods.description: Sets whether this product type can be added to cart.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code associated with this product type.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for this product type.
